## Core Service Verticals & Pricing Architecture

### 1. Video Production & Editing
High-retention video post-production for digital creators, founders, and modern brands.
- **Starting Price**: ₹799 per video
- **Tiers & Packages**:
  - *Starter Reel* (₹799 / video): Hook-first cuts, animated captions, color grading, pacing.
  - *Talking Head & YouTube* (₹1,499 / video): Multi-angle cuts, sound design, lower thirds, zoom transitions.
  - *Motion Graphics Reel* (₹2,499 / video): Advanced 2D motion graphics, 3D typography, bespoke SFX.
- **Turnaround**: 2 to 5 business days per batch.
- **Deliverables**: 9:16 vertical & 16:9 exports, sound leveling, subtitle files.

### 2. Pitch Decks & Storytelling
Compelling visual narratives and investor presentations designed for fundraising, keynotes, and sales.
- **Starting Price**: ₹3,999 per deck
- **Tiers & Packages**:
  - *Starter Pitch Deck* (₹3,999 / 10-12 slides): Structure cleanup, core narrative, visual polish.
  - *Investor Ready Deck* (₹7,999 / 15-20 slides): Full market sizing, traction charts, financial modeling layout.
  - *Keynote & Flagship* (₹14,999 / up to 30 slides): Custom 3D/2D graphics, speaker staging, animation passes.
- **Turnaround**: 5 to 10 business days.
- **Deliverables**: Editable Keynote, PowerPoint, or Figma file + high-res vector PDF export.

### 3. Web Development
Bespoke, hand-crafted digital web applications and landing pages with fluid 2D motion and sub-second load times. Zero page-builder bloat.
- **Starting Price**: ₹7,999 one-time
- **Tiers & Packages**:
  - *High-Conversion Landing Page* (₹7,999): Single-page storytelling, responsive motion, form integration, SEO metadata.
  - *Multi-Page Brand Site* (₹14,999): Up to 5 pages, CMS connection, interactive showcase, analytics.
  - *Custom Web App / Platform* (₹24,999): Headless frontend, database integrations (Supabase, APIs), auth, real-time features.
- **Turnaround**: 2 to 4 weeks.
- **Deliverables**: Source code, high-performance deployment on Vercel/Cloudflare, 95+ Lighthouse audit guarantee.

### 4. AI Solutions & Automation
Event-driven automations and autonomous AI agents grounded in your proprietary documentation and business tools.
- **Starting Price**: ₹5,999 one-time
- **Tiers & Packages**:
  - *Workflow Automation Sprint* (₹5,999): Connects CRMs, Slack, inboxes, and spreadsheets to eliminate manual tasks.
  - *Custom AI Agent / Chatbot* (₹11,999): Grounded in custom knowledge bases, hard guardrails against hallucinations, human escalation handoff.
  - *Full AI Business OS* (₹24,999): End-to-end autonomous pipeline unifying lead qualification, customer inquiries, and cross-tool actions.
- **Turnaround**: 2 to 3 weeks.
- **Deliverables**: Deployed webhook workflows, documentation, testing passes, and 30-day warranty.

---

## Studio Principles & Commercial Terms
1. **Fixed Milestones & Defined Deliverables**: Every engagement receives an exact technical scope with deliverables, duration limits, and total investment in writing. No open-ended hourly drift.
2. **50% Commitment Deposit**: 50% deposit locks the production timeline; the remaining balance is due upon final milestone approval and before export handoff or deployment.
3. **Structured Revision Passes**: Every package includes consolidated revision rounds (typically 2-3 passes) to refine timing, copy, styling, and grading.
4. **Connected Architecture**: Engagements can start with a single vertical (e.g., video editing or a pitch deck) and scale into a unified system across web and AI.
